caption: A flashlight lying on a table and pointed at a wall is switched on, and a bright spot appears on the wall.

sa.check: A flashlight lies on a table, pointed at a wall.
A bright spot appears on the wall.
The wall is unlit by the flashlight before the switch.
The order is off, switch, spot on the wall.

pc.expect: The spot appears on the wall at the moment the switch is pressed, and only then; it lies where the flashlight points.
pc.fail: The switch is pressed and the wall stays as before; or the spot is on the wall before the switch is touched; or the spot appears on a part of the wall the flashlight does not point at; or the lens glows while the wall stays dark.

pc.expect: Once on, the spot stays steady on the wall for the rest of the clip while the flashlight lies still.
pc.fail: The spot goes out again by itself; or flickers; or the spot wanders across the wall while the flashlight lies still; or the spot grows and shrinks with the flashlight untouched.

pc.expect: The lit lens and the spot appear together; the beam's path lights any dust or objects between them, and the spot is brightest at its centre.
pc.fail: The lens is dark while the spot is on the wall; or the spot is lit while the lens stays dark; or an object placed in the beam casts no shadow on the wall.

pc.expect: The flashlight stays where it lies as it is switched on, apart from a small nudge from the hand; nothing else on the table moves.
pc.fail: The flashlight rolls or slides across the table with nothing touching it; or lifts off the table; or other items on the table shift at the switch.

pc.expect: One flashlight and one spot; the flashlight keeps its shape; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second flashlight or a second spot appears; or the flashlight vanishes; or the hand passes through the flashlight; or the wall changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The flashlight's colour, the table and the wall's colour stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The flashlight changes colour; or the wall changes colour rather than brightness; or the table's contents rearrange.
